D/ IMP LICINIVS PF AVG ; R/ SOLI INVICTO COMITI

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Licinius I (308-324), Soli Invicto issue of 310-319, possibly London mint issue, Reece period 15; if so, possibly RIC vol. 7 page 102 no. 97, issue of 316-317. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: IMP LICINIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe, cloak over left arm. C V in field. Reverse inscription: SOLI INVICTO COMITI. In exergue: PL[?N]. Diameter: 19.6mm, Weight: 2.34gms, die axis: 6
